# IEEEtran provenance

Downloaded 2026-09-11 from the CTAN distribution:
https://mirrors.ctan.org/macros/latex/contrib/IEEEtran.zip

Package listing: https://ctan.org/pkg/ieeetran

IEEE author guidance:
https://conferences.ieeeauthorcenter.ieee.org/write-your-paper/authoring-tools-and-templates/

The `IEEEtran/` directory is the complete unmodified extracted distribution.
The class reports version 1.8b (2015-08-26); the BibTeX style reports version
1.14 (2015-08-26). Upstream copyright, contribution notices, legal notices,
examples, and documentation are retained. The class is distributed under LPPL
1.3; consult the individual upstream files for their applicable notices.
No upstream formatting source was modified.

SHA-256:

```text
E0CD4F5AFBD42C8076092280E72B3E0A5111EFE501D35DE9F715CFB8DA313CB4  IEEEtran.zip
DA751920A317ED318B7B5CD7FA585A6CC7D28502D457856382E9BE24B10A3BD7  IEEEtran/IEEEtran.cls
314F0ECE704568FAF827011BAC498650691B2B5EE06320720830E782416D5A5F  IEEEtran/bibtex/IEEEtran.bst
```

The upstream ZIP used to verify these hashes was downloaded into
`.temp/white-paper/IEEEtran.zip`; the organization migration preserved it at
`.local/archive/session-work/white-paper/IEEEtran.zip`. This source directory
contains the complete extracted files, so rebuilding needs no CTAN download.
